'''Flying Carriers''' are a [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Inborn Parasites|Inborn]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned by [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
*Spawns from [[Evolution Phases|Phase 3]] to [[Evolution Phases|Phase 4]] with spawnweight of 15.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Flying Carriers are Aerial Infestation Propagators that hold other infectors.

* Flying Carriers will explode when they get close to the entity they are targeting or upon death (assuming they are not on fire). 
** This explosion can spawn several mobs ([[Flying Carrier#Carrier Mob Contents|More info below]]) and will inflict the [[Viral]] Effect.
** The area where they exploded will spawn the aforementioned Mobs together with a Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]] Cloud<ref>This unique effect cloud is known in the mod as "srparasites:cloudtoxic."</ref>.
{{Variants|count=1|Empty=Flying Carrier.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Flying Carriers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Flying Carriers on fire will not explode or release anything upon death.

|tier=Inborn
